description: This file defines an HTML webpage that includes a script to create and register a Calculator service class, which extends a base Service class and registers 'add' and 'sub' methods; it also initializes a ServiceManager and connects to a server.

classes.name: Calculator
classes.description: A JavaScript class extending Service, implementing 'add' and 'sub' methods for remote procedure calls.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Calculates the sum of an array of numbers, returning a Promise with the result.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Subtracts the second parameter from the first, returning a Promise with the result.
